variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.body: An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Ballots before the business of government
variants.body: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: An Assembly election enters the record
variants.body: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
